subject: LatticeGrid late-stage: provisional sizing + fleet guardrail check
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: LatticeGrid late-stage: provisional sizing + fleet guardrail check

Team —

Quick context: LatticeGrid (large-edge analytics) is in final contract talks. Legal/finance are nearly done; procurement asked us to confirm a provisional pool we can hold while they finish PO/signature. Their ask below (from Samir) is: 24 dedicated GPUs at sustained 8–10 TFLOPS-equivalent throughput for 90 days, with burst up to 40 GPU-equivalents during their ramp windows. They expect to go live with our dedicated pool by 2029-12-10 if we can hold capacity.

I need a realistic internal availability check and a recommended "soft-hold" configuration we can offer today. Specifically:
- Preferred HW mix (A100 80GB vs H100) for their model mix (large chat + rerank + embeddings).
- Minimum guaranteed GPUs to put on provisional hold (and a recommended burst buffer).
- Impact on other pending commitments (notably the Orion and Helio windows next month).
- Suggested expiration/roll-off for the soft-hold (e.g., 30d auto-release unless PO received).

Please reply with a short ops snapshot and a concrete hold proposal we can share with Samir by EOD Thursday (11/7). Attach any relevant fleet snapshots.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

--
Attachment: latticegrid_commit_profile.pdf (summary from deal team)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2029 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LatticeGrid late-stage: provisional sizing + fleet guardrail check

Avery —

Attached snapshot (fleet_snapshot_20291106.csv) and quick read below. Numbers are capacity from current regional pools, excluding already-reserved dedicated contracts.

Current standing (US regions combined):
- Available A100 80GB nodes (full GPUs): 46
- Available H100 nodes (full GPUs): 8 (very constrained; several nodes reserved for scheduled infra upgrades 11/14–11/20)
- Known pending commitments (probable but not yet reserved): Orion (20 GPUs) window 11/20–12/28; HelioApps soft hold (12 GPUs) tentatively 12/01–03/31.

Recommendation (provisional hold proposal):
1) Offer a soft 24-GPU hold, backed by A100 80GB. Justification: LatticeGrid's model mix (sustained inference + embeddings) is memory-heavy; A100 gives best cost/fit for the initial 90-day runway.
2) Provide a 40-GPU burst bucket (best-effort) that triggers autoscale if utilization exceeds 85% for 5 continuous minutes — but only if we can shift lower-priority spot capacity. Burst will be explicitly non-guaranteed in the provisional terms.
3) Soft-hold terms: 21-day confirmation window once PO is submitted; otherwise the hold auto-expires. If they provide a signed PO, convert to a reserved pool and pin model variant.
4) Contention mitigation: mark Orion window as high-priority; if Orion converts to a hard reserve, we recommend negotiating a phased first-90d placement across two zones to avoid hot conflicts.

Operational caveats:
- H100 availability is insufficient for a full H100 hold; if Lattice insists on H100 for perf, we can propose mixed placement (A100 for baseline, H100 on-demand with premium pricing).
- Maintenance window 11/14–11/20 reduces cluster flexibility next week; recommend we avoid converting large soft-holds to hard reserves until after 11/21.

I attached a draft MOU (mou-provisional-hold-draft.pdf) that legal can tweak; added a stub clause for auto-release.

Marissa Cole
Director, Fleet & Capacity Operations
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
--
Attachments: fleet_snapshot_20291106.csv, mou-provisional-hold-draft.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@latticegrid.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@latticegrid.com
Date: Thu, 7 Nov 2029 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LatticeGrid late-stage: provisional sizing + fleet guardrail check

Avery / Lauren —

Thanks for the quick follow-up, and thanks Marissa for the detail. A couple clarifying points from our side before we sign anything:

1) The 24-GPU baseline looks reasonable. Can Redwood confirm the earliest contract-start date you can guarantee if we sign by next Wednesday (11/13)? We are aiming to begin onboarding the dev team 2029-12-10.
2) On burst: we need a clear SLA on burst availability windows (we understand it may be best-effort) — can you provide a guardrail we can include in the MOU?
3) Cost sensitivity: we need to confirm pricing for mixed placement (A100 baseline + H100 burst) — if you can provide a simple delta per GPU-hour that we can show procurement, that will expedite PO sign-off.

We are prepared to provide a soft signature on the MOU pending confirmation of the window and the price delta.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, LatticeGrid
samir.patel@latticegrid.com
--

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@latticegrid.com>, procurement@latticegrid.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Nov 2029 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LatticeGrid late-stage: provisional sizing + fleet guardrail check

Samir / procurement team —

Thanks — quick confirmations below so procurement can move forward:

- Start date: If LatticeGrid signs the MOU by 2029-11-13, we can lock a soft-held A100 pool to be available and begin onboarding on 2029-12-10. Hard reserve conversion will be scheduled for 2029-12-01 to allow provisioning and testing.
- Burst guardrail: Marissa proposes a documented best-effort burst bucket of 40 GPUs with the following guardrails: 1) burst availability is subject to a 20% buffer for emergency internal ops; 2) burst may be preempted for SLA-backed conversions (we will give 48-hour notice unless immediate safety required). We'll insert this language in the MOU.
- Pricing delta: Rishi — can you add a simple line item: +$3.50 / GPU-hour for H100 burst over A100 baseline (est.). If we can get a short pricing table by Monday morning I'll paste it into the MOU for procurement.

Next steps:
1) Rishi to provide H100 delta + short pricing table (by 11/11).
2) Marissa to publish the soft-hold (24 A100 baseline + 40 GPU burst bucket) in capacity ops and attach a provisional hold ID: PH-2029-445-LG. Soft-hold will auto-expire in 21 days unless PO arrives.
3) Avery to push the MOU & HubSpot deal link to procurement; Samir to sign soft MOU once pricing guardrail is posted.

I'll attach the provisional hold MOU & sprint needs (gpu_sprint_needs.xlsx) in the HubSpot thread.

Thanks everyone —
Avery
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
--
Attachments: gpu_sprint_needs.xlsx, mou-provisional-hold-draft.pdf
